scope: Diagnostic probes only. No native Keel-linked kernel image was produced.
partial_object_producer: GNU ld -r over the qualified Keel archives; isolates final-link input support from archive/partial-link gaps.
note_removal: GNU objcopy 2.46 --remove-section=.note.Linux on a disposable diagnostic copy only. Qualified boot images were not modified.
script_requirements: ENTRY with absolute physical entry expression
SECTIONS with a high virtual location counter
AT/ADDR for distinct physical load addresses
Symbol definitions, aliases, ABSOLUTE and PROVIDE
INFO and CONSTRUCTORS syntax present in pinned script
implementation_requirements: Separate file offsets, virtual addresses and physical load addresses in the layout model.
Script expression evaluation and symbol resolution must participate in layout, not only command parsing.
Allow script-defined absolute entries; current entry validation requires a code-section symbol.
Preserve bounded allocated Linux notes and emit the requested PT_NOTE.
Select whole archives and rescan explicit groups; add ET_REL output for the pinned partial-link step.
